ideas.title: Griffith Observatory at sunset
ideas.desc: Free to get in. Walk the terrace for the whole city plus the Hollywood sign. Free telescopes on clear nights.

ideas.title: Free day at the Getty
ideas.desc: Free entry (parking costs extra). Gardens, views and art. Go late afternoon for sunset.

ideas.title: Venice Beach boardwalk
ideas.desc: Street performers, skaters and the skatepark. People watching is the main event.

ideas.title: Walk the Venice Canals
ideas.desc: Quiet little bridges a block from the boardwalk. Great photos.

ideas.title: Urban Light at night
ideas.desc: The famous lamp posts outside LACMA. Free to see, glows after dark.

ideas.title: Santa Monica Pier sunset
ideas.desc: Ferris wheel, arcade and churros. Free to walk, rides cost extra.

ideas.title: Hollywood sign view from Lake Hollywood Park
ideas.desc: Easiest close-up view of the sign. Bring a blanket.

ideas.title: El Matador State Beach
ideas.desc: Sea caves and rock arches. Go at low tide.

ideas.title: Grand Central Market food crawl
ideas.desc: Split a few stalls between the group. Something for everyone.

ideas.title: The Last Bookstore
ideas.desc: Book tunnel upstairs, cheap used books, very photogenic.

ideas.title: Echo Park Lake walk
ideas.desc: Loop the lake, see the swan boats and the fountain. Boat rentals extra.

ideas.title: Manhattan Beach Pier sunset
ideas.desc: Walk to the end of the pier, then grab food on the strip.

ideas.title: Little Tokyo dessert crawl
ideas.desc: Mochi, taiyaki and boba within a few blocks.

ideas.title: Abbot Kinney window shopping
ideas.desc: Murals, boutiques and coffee. Fun even if you buy nothing.

ideas.title: Koreatown karaoke night
ideas.desc: Private rooms by the hour, split it with the group.

ideas.title: Korean BBQ in Koreatown
ideas.desc: All-you-can-eat spots are perfect for big groups. Go hungry.

ideas.title: Smorgasburg on Sunday
ideas.desc: Outdoor food market with dozens of vendors. Sundays only.

ideas.title: The Broad (free)
ideas.desc: Free contemporary art museum. Reserve a time online.

ideas.title: Runyon Canyon hike
ideas.desc: Short steep loop with city views. Busy, go early.

ideas.title: Baldwin Hills Overlook stairs
ideas.desc: Climb the stairs for a huge view from downtown to the ocean.

ideas.title: Original Farmers Market and The Grove
ideas.desc: Snack stands, then walk The Grove. Great at night with the lights.

ideas.title: Dodgers game
ideas.desc: Cheap seats are fine. Go for the Dodger Dog and the sunset over the hills.

ideas.title: Movie night at Hollywood Forever
ideas.desc: Cinespia outdoor movies in summer. Bring blankets and snacks.

ideas.title: Olvera Street
ideas.desc: Oldest street in LA. Taquitos, churros and little shops. Free to wander.

ideas.title: Bowling at Shatto 39 Lanes
ideas.desc: Old-school bowling alley in Koreatown. Cheap and fun for groups.

ideas.title: Arts District mural walk
ideas.desc: Huge murals every block. Bring a camera.

ideas.title: Point Vicente sunset
ideas.desc: Cliffs over the ocean. Whale watching in winter.

ideas.title: Universal CityWalk
ideas.desc: Free to walk around. Food, shops and lights at night.

ideas.title: Sawtelle Japantown eats
ideas.desc: Ramen, boba and dessert on one street.

ideas.title: Old Pasadena night walk
ideas.desc: Walkable shops, food and alleys. Easy hangout.

ideas.title: Rose Bowl Flea Market
ideas.desc: Giant flea market the second Sunday of the month. Go early.

ideas.title: Mulholland overlook at night
ideas.desc: Pull over for the valley lights. Bring a jacket.

ideas.title: Leo's Tacos truck
ideas.desc: Al pastor off the spit. Late night classic.

ideas.title: Beach volleyball in Hermosa
ideas.desc: Courts all along the sand. Bring a ball.

ideas.title: Bonfire at Dockweiler
ideas.desc: Fire rings right on the sand. Bring wood and s'mores.
ideas.area: Playa del Rey, Los Angeles, CA

ideas.title: Angels Flight ride
ideas.desc: Tiny funicular, costs about a dollar. Pair it with Grand Central Market.

ideas.title: Disney Concert Hall rooftop garden
ideas.desc: Free hidden garden on top of the building.

ideas.title: Silver Lake Reservoir loop
ideas.desc: Flat 2 mile walk with dogs, joggers and coffee nearby.

ideas.title: Concert at the Hollywood Bowl
ideas.desc: Summer shows under the stars. Bring a picnic.

ideas.title: Thrifting on Melrose
ideas.desc: Vintage and thrift shops for blocks. Set a budget.

ideas.title: Barnsdall Park sunset picnic
ideas.desc: Hilltop lawn with a view and almost nobody there.

ideas.title: Fern Dell trail in Griffith Park
ideas.desc: Shady creek trail, then up to the observatory.

ideas.title: Zuma Beach day
ideas.desc: Wide sandy beach, good for groups and frisbee.

ideas.title: Candy Cane Lane lights
ideas.desc: Whole neighborhood lights up in December. Walk it, don't drive.

ideas.title: LA Zoo Lights
ideas.desc: Holiday light show at the zoo. Tickets needed, check this year's dates.

ideas.title: Diddy Riese cookie ice cream sandwich
ideas.desc: The cheapest dessert in Westwood. Line moves fast, go after dinner.

ideas.title: Hammer Museum (free)
ideas.desc: Always free. Small enough to see in an hour, nice courtyard to sit.

ideas.title: Hidden garden at UCLA
ideas.desc: A free little jungle tucked into campus. Quiet, shady, barely anyone there.

ideas.title: UCLA sculpture garden picnic
ideas.desc: Big lawn surrounded by sculptures. Bring a blanket and snacks.

ideas.title: Janss Steps workout
ideas.desc: Run the steps a few times, then sit at the top and people-watch.

ideas.title: Tsujita tsukemen
ideas.desc: Thick dipping ramen. Lunch line is shorter than dinner.

ideas.title: Movie at the Regency Village
ideas.desc: Old-school movie palace with a huge screen. Premieres happen here.

ideas.title: Persian food on Westwood Blvd
ideas.desc: Tehrangeles staple. Get the ash reshteh and a sandwich to share.

ideas.title: Late-night slice in Westwood
ideas.desc: Big New York slices, open late. Classic after-movie stop.

ideas.title: Window shop Rodeo Drive
ideas.desc: Free to look. Walk Via Rodeo and the steps for the classic photos.

ideas.title: Sprinkles cupcake ATM
ideas.desc: A 24-hour vending machine for cupcakes. Late-night dessert run.

ideas.title: Greystone Mansion gardens
ideas.desc: Free hilltop gardens behind a famous mansion. Feels like a secret.

ideas.title: Franklin Canyon lake
ideas.desc: Hidden lake in the hills, 5 minutes from Sunset. Easy loop, ducks, turtles.

ideas.title: Tito's Tacos
ideas.desc: Crunchy shell tacos with a mountain of cheese. Cash-friendly, quick.

ideas.title: Museum of Jurassic Technology
ideas.desc: The strangest museum in LA. Dark rooms, odd exhibits, tea room on the roof.

ideas.title: Bouldering at Cliffs of Id
ideas.desc: No experience needed. Day pass plus shoe rental, then climb together.

ideas.title: Sunset at Kenneth Hahn park
ideas.desc: Ponds, trails and a ridge with views from downtown to the ocean.

ideas.title: Santa Monica Stairs
ideas.desc: Steep public stairs locals use as a workout. Ocean view at the top.

ideas.title: Tongva Park hangout
ideas.desc: Hills, fountains and an ocean lookout right by the pier.

ideas.title: Santa Monica farmers market
ideas.desc: Wednesday and Saturday mornings on Arizona Ave. Graze samples, grab fruit.

ideas.title: Third Street Promenade
ideas.desc: Street performers, shops, and it ends at the pier. Free to wander.

ideas.title: Bike the Strand to Venice
ideas.desc: Rent bikes or scooters by the pier and ride the beach path south.

ideas.title: Watch the Venice Skatepark
ideas.desc: Pros carving bowls next to the sand. Best right before sunset.

ideas.title: Venice drum circle
ideas.desc: Sundays near sunset by the boardwalk. Dance, drum, or just watch.

ideas.title: Roller skating at Venice
ideas.desc: Rent skates nearby and join the roller disco crowd.

ideas.title: Gjusta bakery run
ideas.desc: Huge counter of pastries and sandwiches. Eat on the back patio.

ideas.title: The viral Erewhon smoothie
ideas.desc: Yes it costs $20. Split one and decide if the hype is real.

ideas.title: Kayak in Marina del Rey
ideas.desc: Calm water, no waves. Rent kayaks or paddleboards by the hour.

ideas.title: See the Space Shuttle Endeavour
ideas.desc: Free general entry (the shuttle may need a timed ticket).

ideas.title: Exposition Park Rose Garden
ideas.desc: Thousands of roses, free, right next to USC. Great for photos.

ideas.title: Dinosaur hall at the Natural History Museum
ideas.desc: T. rex growth series and a butterfly pavilion in spring.

ideas.title: LAFC match
ideas.desc: Loudest crowd in LA. The supporters section never sits down.

ideas.title: Mercado La Paloma food hall
ideas.desc: Home of Holbox seafood. Cheaper and calmer than the trendy halls.

ideas.title: Velaslavasay Panorama
ideas.desc: A tiny old theater with a 360 painted panorama. Real hidden gem near USC.

ideas.title: Leimert Park Sunday drum circle
ideas.desc: Drums, vendors and Black-owned shops. Sunday afternoons.

ideas.title: Watts Towers
ideas.desc: Hand-built towers of steel and broken tile. Free to see from outside.

ideas.title: Randy's Donuts
ideas.desc: The giant donut on the roof. 24 hours, drive-through.

ideas.title: In-N-Out under the LAX planes
ideas.desc: Eat in the park across the street while jets land right overhead.

ideas.title: Bradbury Building lobby
ideas.desc: Iron staircases and a glass roof from Blade Runner. Lobby is free to peek in.

ideas.title: Grand Park picnic
ideas.desc: Pink chairs, a splash fountain and City Hall views.

ideas.title: Daikokuya ramen
ideas.desc: Rich tonkotsu, small room. Put your name down and walk Little Tokyo.

ideas.title: Mochi at Fugetsu-Do
ideas.desc: Family mochi shop open for over 100 years.

ideas.title: Hauser & Wirth gallery (free)
ideas.desc: Huge free art space in an old flour mill, plus a chicken coop garden.

ideas.title: French dip at Philippe's
ideas.desc: Sawdust floors, cheap coffee, double-dipped sandwiches.

ideas.title: Union Station waiting room
ideas.desc: Art deco lobby with giant leather chairs. Free and gorgeous.

ideas.title: MOCA Grand (free)
ideas.desc: General entry is free. Pair it with The Broad across the street.

ideas.title: 2nd Street Tunnel photos
ideas.desc: The glowing white tile tunnel from car ads. Shoot from the sidewalk only.

ideas.title: 6th Street Bridge at night
ideas.desc: Lit-up arches and the skyline. Walk it, stay on the sidewalk.

ideas.title: Santee Alley bargain hunt
ideas.desc: Cheap clothes, sunglasses and snacks. Set a $20 budget and compete.

ideas.title: Guisados tacos
ideas.desc: Stewed tacos on fresh tortillas. Order the sampler to try six.

ideas.title: Mariachi Plaza
ideas.desc: Mariachis wait here to get hired. Grab a churro and listen.

ideas.title: Mariscos Jalisco shrimp tacos
ideas.desc: Famous truck. Crispy shrimp tacos with avocado salsa.

ideas.title: Manuel's El Tepeyac
ideas.desc: Burritos the size of your arm. Split the Hollenbeck.

ideas.title: Sonoratown flour tortilla tacos
ideas.desc: Thin flour tortillas made by hand. Get the chivichanga.

ideas.title: Lakers game from the cheap seats
ideas.desc: Upper-level seats on a weeknight are the move. LA Live after.

ideas.title: Howlin' Ray's hot chicken
ideas.desc: The line is part of it. Pick your heat honestly.

ideas.title: Chinatown Central Plaza lanterns
ideas.desc: Red lanterns strung overhead. Best right after dark.

ideas.title: LA State Historic Park picnic
ideas.desc: Big open lawn with downtown views. Frisbee and a blanket.

ideas.title: Angels Point in Elysian Park
ideas.desc: Hilltop above Dodger Stadium with skyline views. Quiet at sunset.

ideas.title: Vista Hermosa skyline view
ideas.desc: Small park with a meadow framed by downtown towers.

ideas.title: Langer's #19 pastrami
ideas.desc: Some say the best pastrami in the country. Open for lunch only.

ideas.title: Free summer concerts at MacArthur Park
ideas.desc: Free outdoor shows in summer. Check the season lineup.

ideas.title: Grand Performances (free)
ideas.desc: Free summer concerts by the fountains. Dancing encouraged.

ideas.title: Chili burger at Original Tommy's
ideas.desc: The original shack, open late. Messy, cheap, iconic.

ideas.title: BCD Tofu House
ideas.desc: Bubbling tofu soup and endless banchan. Open late.

ideas.title: Korean spa day
ideas.desc: Hot rooms, cold pools and cheap food upstairs. Open 24 hours.

ideas.title: Galbi jjim at Sun Nong Dan
ideas.desc: Braised short ribs covered in melted cheese. Share one pot.

ideas.title: Pollo a la Brasa
ideas.desc: Wood-fired Peruvian chicken. Get a whole one for the group.

ideas.title: Pink's Hot Dogs
ideas.desc: Hollywood hot dog stand since 1939. Open late on weekends.

ideas.title: Dig through records at Amoeba
ideas.desc: Giant record store. Everyone picks one album under $10 for someone else.

ideas.title: Walk of Fame and the handprints
ideas.desc: Touristy but everyone should do it once. Find your favorite star.

ideas.title: Bronson Caves (the Batcave)
ideas.desc: Short easy walk to the cave from the old Batman show.

ideas.title: Hike to the Wisdom Tree
ideas.desc: Steep but short. One lonely tree with a notebook to sign at the top.

ideas.title: Stand-up at the Comedy Store
ideas.desc: Famous comics drop in unannounced. Check the age limit for each show.

ideas.title: Late night at Canter's Deli
ideas.desc: Open very late. Matzo ball soup after a night out.

ideas.title: LACMA after 3pm
ideas.desc: Free for LA County residents after 3pm on weekdays.

ideas.title: La Brea Tar Pits
ideas.desc: Bubbling tar in the middle of the city. The park around it is free.

ideas.title: Hollywood farmers market
ideas.desc: Sundays on Ivar and Selma. Breakfast tacos, fruit, people-watching.

ideas.title: Thai Town at Jitlada
ideas.desc: Very spicy southern Thai. Ask for medium unless you mean it.

ideas.title: Late-night boat noodles in Thai Town
ideas.desc: Open late and cheap. Classic after-show stop.

ideas.title: Zankou Chicken
ideas.desc: The garlic sauce is the whole point. Cheap and filling.

ideas.title: Brunch at République
ideas.desc: Gorgeous room, amazing pastries. Go early on weekends.

ideas.title: Show at the Troubadour
ideas.desc: Legendary small club. Some shows are 21+, check before buying.

ideas.title: Climb the Music Box Steps
ideas.desc: The stairs from a 1932 Laurel and Hardy movie. Secret stairs everywhere nearby.

ideas.title: Courage Bagels
ideas.desc: The viral bagel line. Go early, it sells out.

ideas.title: Pine & Crane
ideas.desc: Taiwanese comfort food, order at the counter. Dan dan noodles.

ideas.title: Movie at the Vista Theatre
ideas.desc: Restored 1920s single-screen theater. Feels like a premiere every time.

ideas.title: Browse Skylight Books
ideas.desc: Indie bookstore with a tree growing through it.

ideas.title: Late-night Taco Zone truck
ideas.desc: Parks at night near the Vons on Alvarado. Al pastor off the trompo.

ideas.title: Picnic at the Old Zoo
ideas.desc: Abandoned animal enclosures you can walk into. Picnic tables nearby.

ideas.title: Griffith Park merry-go-round
ideas.desc: 1926 carousel, a few bucks a ride. Weekends.

ideas.title: Concert at the Greek Theatre
ideas.desc: Outdoor amphitheater in the trees. Summer and fall shows.

ideas.title: Show at The Echo
ideas.desc: Small club for up-and-coming bands. Check age limits.

ideas.title: Porto's Bakery
ideas.desc: Cuban pastries and potato balls for a dollar or two. Get a box to share.

ideas.title: Americana fountain show
ideas.desc: Dancing fountain set to music, plus a trolley. Free to hang out.

ideas.title: Brand Library & Park
ideas.desc: A white mansion library at the foot of the hills. Quiet and free.

ideas.title: Bike the LA River path
ideas.desc: Flat path along the river in Frogtown. Cafes and breweries along the way.

ideas.title: Wanderlust Creamery
ideas.desc: Ice cream flavors from around the world. Try a bunch of samples.

ideas.title: Highland Park Bowl
ideas.desc: Restored 1920s bowling alley. Check age rules before going at night.

ideas.title: Donut Friend
ideas.desc: Donuts named after punk bands. Walk York Blvd thrift shops after.

ideas.title: Joy on York
ideas.desc: Taiwanese street food. Popcorn chicken and dan dan noodles.

ideas.title: Debs Park hike
ideas.desc: Hidden pond and views on the Eastside. Rarely crowded.

ideas.title: Ascot Hills sunset
ideas.desc: Grassy hills with a skyline view almost no one knows about.

ideas.title: The Iliad Bookshop (with cats)
ideas.desc: Giant used bookstore with resident cats. Cheap finds.

ideas.title: Descanso Gardens
ideas.desc: Oak forest and camellias. Holiday light walk in winter.

ideas.title: Colorado Street Bridge
ideas.desc: Old arched bridge over the Arroyo. Golden hour photos.

ideas.title: Huntington gardens on free day
ideas.desc: Free first Thursday of the month with a reservation. Otherwise paid.

ideas.title: Norton Simon Museum free night
ideas.desc: Free on the first Friday evening of the month. Van Goghs and a sculpture garden.

ideas.title: Rose Bowl loop
ideas.desc: Three-mile flat loop. Walk, run or skate it.

ideas.title: Pie 'n Burger
ideas.desc: Diner counter, great burgers, pie for dessert.

ideas.title: Vroman's Bookstore
ideas.desc: Oldest indie bookstore in Southern California.

ideas.title: UCLA football at the Rose Bowl
ideas.desc: Tailgate in the Arroyo first. Student-priced tickets go fast.

ideas.title: Boba crawl on Valley Blvd
ideas.desc: SGV has the best boba in LA. Hit three shops and rank them.

ideas.title: Peacocks at the Arboretum
ideas.desc: Peacocks roam free next to a waterfall and lagoon.

ideas.title: Lake Balboa cherry blossoms
ideas.desc: Pink trees around a lake in early spring. Paddle boats too.

ideas.title: Japanese Garden in the Valley
ideas.desc: Quiet garden with koi and a teahouse. Check opening days.

ideas.title: Friday car show at Bob's Big Boy
ideas.desc: Classic cars fill the lot on Friday nights. Burgers and shakes.

ideas.title: Day trip to Vasquez Rocks
ideas.desc: Giant tilted rocks from Star Trek. Climb around, bring water.

ideas.title: Point Dume cliffs
ideas.desc: Short climb to a cliff with whale views in winter. Hidden cove below.

ideas.title: Neptune's Net
ideas.desc: Seafood shack by the surfers on PCH. Fried shrimp on the patio.

ideas.title: Redondo Beach Pier
ideas.desc: Arcade, fried seafood and sea lions under the pier.

ideas.title: Abalone Cove tide pools
ideas.desc: Go at low tide. Crabs, anemones and sea caves.

ideas.title: Korean Bell of Friendship
ideas.desc: Giant bronze bell on a cliff over the ocean. Windy and beautiful.

ideas.title: Naples canals walk
ideas.desc: Little canals with gondolas. Huge holiday lights in December.

ideas.title: Thrift Retro Row
ideas.desc: Vintage shops on 4th Street. $20 outfit challenge.

ideas.title: Queen Mary from Shoreline Village
ideas.desc: Harbor walk with the Queen Mary across the water.

ideas.title: CSULB Japanese Garden
ideas.desc: Koi pond on campus. Check opening days, it's free.

ideas.title: Signal Hill sunset
ideas.desc: Views over Long Beach to the ocean and downtown LA.

ideas.title: Dolores Park picnic
ideas.desc: Grab burritos, find a spot on the hill with the skyline view.

ideas.title: Twin Peaks sunset
ideas.desc: The whole city at your feet. Bring a jacket, it gets windy.

ideas.title: Lands End trail and Sutro Baths
ideas.desc: Cliff trail with Golden Gate views, ending at old bath ruins.

ideas.title: Walk across the Golden Gate Bridge
ideas.desc: Start at the welcome center, walk to the first tower and back.

ideas.title: Painted Ladies at Alamo Square
ideas.desc: The famous row of houses with downtown behind. Picnic on the hill.

ideas.title: Mission burrito at La Taqueria
ideas.desc: Get it dorado style (crispy). Rice-free, cash-friendly.

ideas.title: Tartine morning bun
ideas.desc: Go early before the line. Eat it in Dolores Park.

ideas.title: Ferry Building grazing
ideas.desc: Snack your way through the stalls, then sit by the water.

ideas.title: Fortune cookie factory
ideas.desc: Tiny alley shop. Watch them fold cookies, buy a bag of misfits.

ideas.title: Musée Mécanique arcade
ideas.desc: Free entry, antique arcade games for quarters. Bring $5 in change.

ideas.title: 16th Avenue Tiled Steps
ideas.desc: Mosaic staircase in a quiet neighborhood. Climb to Grandview Park for views.

ideas.title: Baker Beach
ideas.desc: Best Golden Gate photo from the sand. Too cold to swim, perfect to sit.

ideas.title: Free tower at the de Young
ideas.desc: The observation tower is free even if you skip the museum.
ideas.area: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA

ideas.title: Japanese Tea Garden
ideas.desc: Arched bridge, koi, tea. Go early for fewer people.
ideas.area: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA

ideas.title: Bernal Heights swing
ideas.desc: Hilltop with a rope swing (when it's up) and big city views.

ideas.title: The Wave Organ
ideas.desc: Pipes on a jetty that hum with the tide. Go at high tide.

ideas.title: Seward Street slides
ideas.desc: Concrete slides on a hill. Bring cardboard. Open on certain hours.

ideas.title: City Lights bookstore
ideas.desc: Famous beat poet bookstore. Upstairs poetry room.

ideas.title: Giants game at Oracle Park
ideas.desc: Cheap bleacher seats, garlic fries, bay views.

ideas.title: Focaccia pizza at Golden Boy
ideas.desc: Square slices, open late. Clam and garlic is the classic.

ideas.title: Palace of Fine Arts
ideas.desc: Giant dome and a lagoon with swans. Free, great photos.

ideas.title: Clarion Alley murals
ideas.desc: An alley covered in political murals that change often.

ideas.title: Ocean Beach bonfire
ideas.desc: Fire rings near the north end. Check the season rules before going.

ideas.title: Exploratorium After Dark
ideas.desc: Adults-only science night on Thursdays. Check the 18+/21+ rule.

ideas.title: Mitchell's Ice Cream
ideas.desc: Tropical flavors like ube and mango since 1953.

ideas.title: Show at The Fillmore
ideas.desc: Free poster after the show. All-ages for most shows.

ideas.title: Warriors game at Chase Center
ideas.desc: Upper level on a weeknight. The plaza outside is fun before the game.

ideas.title: Walk around Lake Merritt
ideas.desc: 3-mile loop. Sunday afternoons have vendors and music.

ideas.title: Fentons Creamery
ideas.desc: Massive sundaes since 1894. Share one.

ideas.title: Indian Rock sunset
ideas.desc: Scramble up a giant boulder for a bay and bridge view.

ideas.title: Cheese Board Pizza
ideas.desc: One veggie pizza a day, live jazz, eat on the median.

ideas.title: Berkeley Rose Garden
ideas.desc: Terraced roses facing the Golden Gate. Sunset spot.

ideas.title: Tilden steam trains
ideas.desc: Tiny steam train ride through the woods for a few bucks.

ideas.title: Hike to the Big C
ideas.desc: Short steep climb above campus. Great view of the bay.

ideas.title: Telegraph Avenue record and book run
ideas.desc: Amoeba, Moe's Books and cheap eats in a few blocks.

ideas.title: Grizzly Peak at night
ideas.desc: Pullouts with the whole bay lit up. Classic night drive.

ideas.title: Albany Bulb art walk
ideas.desc: Old landfill turned into a wild sculpture park on the bay.

ideas.title: Redwoods in Oakland
ideas.desc: Real redwoods 20 minutes from downtown Oakland.

ideas.title: Mount Diablo summit
ideas.desc: Drive (or bike) to the top. On clear days you can see the Sierra.

ideas.title: Broadway Plaza hang
ideas.desc: Outdoor mall, then walk downtown Walnut Creek for food.

ideas.title: Shell Ridge open space hike
ideas.desc: Rolling hills, cows and Diablo views. Golden hour is best.

ideas.title: Heather Farm Park
ideas.desc: Ponds, gardens and big lawns. Easy picnic spot.

ideas.title: Lafayette Reservoir loop
ideas.desc: Paved 2.7-mile loop around the water. Rent a rowboat on weekends.

ideas.title: Hike the Stanford Dish
ideas.desc: Paved hilly loop with a giant radio dish. Busy at sunrise.

ideas.title: Cantor Arts Center (free)
ideas.desc: Free museum with a Rodin sculpture garden outside.

ideas.title: Pillar Point tide pools
ideas.desc: Go at low tide. Mavericks surf break is just offshore.

ideas.title: Arcangeli garlic bread
ideas.desc: Warm artichoke garlic bread on the coast drive. Get two.

ideas.title: Santana Row night out
ideas.desc: Outdoor street of shops and food, fire pits at night.

ideas.title: Winchester Mystery House
ideas.desc: Stairs to nowhere and doors into walls. Flashlight tours around Halloween.

ideas.title: San Jose Japantown eats
ideas.desc: One of the last three Japantowns in the US. Mochi and ramen.

ideas.title: Roller coasters at Great America
ideas.desc: Season passes pay off after two visits.

ideas.title: Muir Woods redwoods
ideas.desc: Reserve parking or the shuttle ahead. Cathedral-like trees.

ideas.title: Walk Sausalito
ideas.desc: Houseboats and bay views. Take the ferry back to SF.

ideas.title: Hawk Hill view
ideas.desc: Best postcard view of the Golden Gate Bridge from above.

ideas.title: Mount Tam East Peak
ideas.desc: Drive up for sunset over the fog.

ideas.title: Point Reyes Lighthouse
ideas.desc: 300 steps down to the lighthouse. Whale watching in winter.

ideas.title: Oysters on Tomales Bay
ideas.desc: Book a picnic table and shuck your own. Split with friends.

ideas.title: Oxbow Public Market
ideas.desc: Food hall in Napa. Fun even if you're not old enough for wine.

ideas.title: Sonoma Plaza afternoon
ideas.desc: Shady old town square. Picnic with bakery and cheese shop finds.

ideas.title: Fern Canyon
ideas.desc: Walls of ferns from Jurassic Park. Day-use permit needed in summer.

ideas.title: Drive the Avenue of the Giants
ideas.desc: 31 miles of redwoods off the 101. Stop and hug a tree.

ideas.title: Old Town Eureka
ideas.desc: Victorian houses, bookstores and waterfront boardwalk.

ideas.title: Burney Falls
ideas.desc: A 129-foot waterfall pouring out of the rocks. Park fee.

ideas.title: Bumpass Hell at Lassen
ideas.desc: Boardwalk over boiling mud pots. Open summer to fall.

ideas.title: Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk
ideas.desc: Wooden roller coaster on the beach since 1924.

ideas.title: Natural Bridges at sunset
ideas.desc: Rock arch in the ocean. Monarch butterflies in winter.

ideas.title: Redwoods at Henry Cowell
ideas.desc: Flat redwood loop and a steam train next door.

ideas.title: Monterey Bay Aquarium
ideas.desc: Kelp forest and jellies. Student discounts exist, ask.

ideas.title: Carmel Beach sunset
ideas.desc: White sand and cypress trees. Bonfires allowed in some spots.

ideas.title: McWay Falls
ideas.desc: Waterfall onto a beach. Check Highway 1 closures first.

ideas.title: Bixby Bridge photo stop
ideas.desc: The Big Sur bridge from every postcard. Pull out north side.

ideas.title: Purple sand at Pfeiffer Beach
ideas.desc: Keyhole arch and purple-streaked sand. Narrow road, small lot.

ideas.title: Old Sacramento
ideas.desc: Gold rush streets, candy shops and the riverfront.

ideas.title: Capitol Park
ideas.desc: Huge trees, squirrels and gardens around the Capitol.

ideas.title: Bike the American River Parkway
ideas.desc: 32-mile trail starts here. Ride as far as you want.

ideas.title: Davis Farmers Market
ideas.desc: Saturdays and Wednesdays. Picnic on the lawn after.

ideas.title: UC Davis Arboretum
ideas.desc: 3.5-mile path along a creek with gardens. Free.

ideas.title: Second Saturday in Midtown
ideas.desc: Galleries open late, street vendors, music. Second Saturday each month.

ideas.title: Folsom Lake day
ideas.desc: Swim, kayak or just sit on the beach. Bring water.

ideas.title: Forestiere Underground Gardens
ideas.desc: Rooms and fruit trees carved underground by one man. Real hidden gem.

ideas.title: Woodward Park
ideas.desc: Big park with a Japanese garden. Picnic and walk.

ideas.title: Swim in Bidwell Park
ideas.desc: Swimming holes in Upper Bidwell. Big summer hangout.

ideas.title: Buck Owens' Crystal Palace
ideas.desc: Live country music and dancing. The Bakersfield sound.

ideas.title: General Sherman Tree
ideas.desc: The largest tree on Earth by volume. Park fee per car, split it.

ideas.title: Tunnel View, Yosemite
ideas.desc: El Capitan, Half Dome and Bridalveil in one view. Check reservations.

ideas.title: Mist Trail to Vernal Fall
ideas.desc: Steep granite steps next to a waterfall. You will get soaked.

ideas.title: Emerald Bay
ideas.desc: The most famous view of Lake Tahoe. Hike down to Vikingsholm.

ideas.title: Heavenly gondola
ideas.desc: Ride up for views over the whole lake. Snow or summer.

ideas.title: Downtown Truckee
ideas.desc: Old railroad town with cafes. Good stop on a Tahoe trip.

ideas.title: Kings Beach lake day
ideas.desc: Clear water, sandy beach, kayak rentals in summer.

ideas.title: Hot Creek Geological Site
ideas.desc: Bright blue boiling creek in a canyon. Look, don't swim.

ideas.title: Badwater Basin, Death Valley
ideas.desc: Lowest point in North America. Go in winter, never summer midday.

ideas.title: Bubblegum Alley
ideas.desc: Gross and iconic. Add your own piece.

ideas.title: Hike Bishop Peak
ideas.desc: Cal Poly's favorite hike. Rocky summit with 360 views.

ideas.title: Pink champagne cake at the Madonna Inn
ideas.desc: The pinkest building in California. Cake to share, then tour the bathrooms.

ideas.title: Pismo Beach pier and dunes
ideas.desc: Clam chowder in a bread bowl, then walk the beach.

ideas.title: Morro Rock
ideas.desc: Giant volcanic rock. Sea otters floating in the harbor.

ideas.title: Hearst Castle tour
ideas.desc: Over-the-top mansion with the famous Neptune Pool.

ideas.title: Elephant seals at Piedras Blancas
ideas.desc: Thousands of seals on the beach. Free boardwalk viewing.

ideas.title: Stearns Wharf and the Funk Zone
ideas.desc: Walk the wharf, then the Funk Zone's murals and shops.

ideas.title: Courthouse clock tower view
ideas.desc: Free tower with red-roof and ocean views. Hidden in plain sight.

ideas.title: Sunset at Campus Point
ideas.desc: UCSB's beach. Bonfire vibes, surfers, dolphins sometimes.

ideas.title: Inspiration Point hike
ideas.desc: Climb above the city for views of the ocean and islands.

ideas.title: Day in Solvang
ideas.desc: Danish village with windmills and pastries. Feels like Europe.

ideas.title: La Super-Rica Taqueria
ideas.desc: Fresh tortillas, small menu, long line. Worth it.

ideas.title: Outdoor bookstore in Ojai
ideas.desc: The biggest outdoor bookstore in the US. Honor-system shelves outside.

ideas.title: Huntington Beach Pier
ideas.desc: Surf City. Watch surfers from the pier, bonfire pits by the sand.

ideas.title: Thousand Steps Beach
ideas.desc: Long stairway to a hidden cove with tide pools and a sea cave.

ideas.title: Crystal Cove beach day
ideas.desc: Old beach cottages, tide pools and the shake shack on the bluff.

ideas.title: Frozen banana on Balboa Island
ideas.desc: The original Balboa bar. Walk around the island after.

ideas.title: Disneyland day
ideas.desc: Expensive but iconic. Go on a weekday, use the app for lines.

ideas.title: Anaheim Packing District
ideas.desc: Food hall in an old citrus packing house. Lots of options.

ideas.title: Irvine Spectrum night
ideas.desc: Ferris wheel, movies and food. UCI's go-to hangout.

ideas.title: Pho in Little Saigon
ideas.desc: Biggest Little Saigon in the US. Pho, banh mi, boba.

ideas.title: Whale watching in Dana Point
ideas.desc: Gray whales in winter, blue whales in summer.

ideas.title: Pirates Cove in Corona del Mar
ideas.desc: Tiny cove with a rock tunnel. Low tide is best.

ideas.title: Mission Inn walk-through
ideas.desc: Castle-like hotel. Huge holiday lights festival in winter.

ideas.title: Mount Rubidoux sunrise
ideas.desc: Paved trail to a cross and big views. UCR's favorite walk.

ideas.title: Big Bear Lake trip
ideas.desc: Snow in winter, kayaks in summer. 2 hours from LA.

ideas.title: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway
ideas.desc: Rotating tram from desert to pine forest in 10 minutes.

ideas.title: Hidden Valley in Joshua Tree
ideas.desc: Boulder scrambling and wild trees. Stay for the stars.

ideas.title: Salvation Mountain
ideas.desc: A painted hill in the desert. Road trip with East Jesus nearby.

ideas.title: Cabazon Dinosaurs
ideas.desc: Giant roadside dinosaurs on the way to Palm Springs.

ideas.title: Old Town Temecula
ideas.desc: Western-style main street, candy shops, Saturday market.

ideas.title: Borrego Springs metal sculptures
ideas.desc: Huge metal dinosaurs and a sea serpent in the desert.

ideas.title: Balboa Park
ideas.desc: Gardens, museums, free organ concerts Sundays.

ideas.title: Sea lions at La Jolla Cove
ideas.desc: Seals and sea lions on the rocks. Kayak to the caves.

ideas.title: Sunset Cliffs
ideas.desc: Cliffs over crashing waves. Stay back from the edge.

ideas.title: Potato Chip Rock
ideas.desc: The famous thin rock photo. Hot hike, start early.

ideas.title: Torrey Pines hike
ideas.desc: Trails to a beach below sandstone cliffs.

ideas.title: Belmont Park coaster
ideas.desc: 1925 wooden coaster on the boardwalk.

ideas.title: Little Italy Mercato
ideas.desc: Saturday farmers market, then gelato.

ideas.title: Las Cuatro Milpas
ideas.desc: Handmade tortillas since 1933. Lunch only, cash.

ideas.title: Chicano Park murals
ideas.desc: Huge murals painted on freeway pillars. Free.

ideas.title: Coronado Beach
ideas.desc: Wide sparkly beach in front of the Hotel del Coronado.

ideas.title: Old Town San Diego
ideas.desc: Historic town and cheap Mexican food.

ideas.title: Padres game at Petco Park
ideas.desc: The Park at the Park has cheap lawn seats.

ideas.title: Convoy Street food crawl
ideas.desc: San Diego's Asian food strip. Ramen, hot pot, boba.

ideas.title: Ocean Beach pier
ideas.desc: Laid-back beach town, long pier, Wednesday farmers market.

ideas.title: Swami's in Encinitas
ideas.desc: Famous surf spot below a meditation garden.

ideas.title: Apple pie in Julian
ideas.desc: Mountain gold rush town known for pie. Snow sometimes in winter.

ideas.title: Geisel Library at UCSD
ideas.desc: The spaceship-looking library. Free to walk around.

ideas.title: Gaslamp Quarter night
ideas.desc: Downtown nightlife district. Lots of 21+, but food and streets are for all.
